```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(harmony)
library(Matrix)
library(pheatmap)

```

# Start with Seurat object
```{r}
query_icell <- readRDS("/storage2/fs1/klavine/Active/Haewon/nicm_donor/ref_mapping/query_icell.rds")
query_10x <- readRDS("/storage2/fs1/klavine/Active/Haewon/nicm_donor/ref_mapping/query_10x.rds")
```

# Get average prediction score
```{r}
meta <- query_icell@meta.data

avg.scores <- meta %>%
  group_by(predicted.celltype) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(predicted.celltype.score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(predicted.celltype.score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells = n()
  )

#write.csv(accuracy_table, "./refmap/mapping_accuracy_10X.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Mapping accuracy

accuracy_table <- meta %>%
  group_by(annot_fig) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    correctly_predicted = sum(predicted.celltype == annot_fig),
    fraction_correct = correctly_predicted / n_cells
  )

#write.csv(avg.scores, file = "./refmap/avg_prediction_scores_per_celltype_10X.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Confusion matrix
```{r}
conf.mat <- table(
  True = meta$annot_fig,
  Predicted = meta$predicted.celltype
)
conf.norm <- prop.table(conf.mat, 1)
```

```{r}
p <- pheatmap(
  conf.norm,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f"
)
```
